overview.text: Morris sponsored the Illinois Menopause Equity and Care Act, which became law in 2026. The legislation requires the state to provide public education on menopause, broadens insurance coverage for related care, and mandates that employers offer reasonable accommodations to workers experiencing menopause. She also carried a bill in the House to allow rideshare drivers to unionize.
